method.bias_transform: margin_ab_bits minus saved bias; A iff shifted margin >= 0
method.both_orders: per-frame AND of two correctness indicators, then unit mean, then seed mean; not an ensemble
method.intervals: paired within-source cluster percentile 95%, unadjusted descriptive; fixed scalar/adapters; sources not resampled
method.units: accuracy fractions and nats; multiply accuracy differences by 100 for pp
method.weighting: equal sources; equal units within source; equal frames/orders within unit; seeds averaged within unit after scoring

scope: Newly inspected post hoc/descriptive comparison; not blind or confirmatory
